title: Back to the Eighth
setup: Black's king stands two squares in front of the c-pawn, holding c6 from c7, and its rook attacks the pawn from b5, so nothing is moving yet.
hint: The black king is doing all the defending from the square next to the pawn. Which line can you take from it?
explanation:
## The Idea

While the king sits on c7, White makes no progress. {{Rh7+}} drives it to the back rank and the rook then owns the seventh, so the king can never come back beside the pawn. {{Kb8}} {{Kd6}} and White's king walks the pawn in.
